format_repair.finding: v26 explicitly re-rendered training rows into the live llama-server prompt format, including the empty think-block generation prefix. Earlier v23/v25 lineage is described as having been trained through a different HF template, creating a silent train/inference format break.
format_repair.mechanism: 30_rendern.py isolates assistant answer spans so loss is applied only to assistant targets while the generation prefix remains prompt context.

runtime_truth_repair.finding: v26.1 introduced deterministic BODY/REALITY fixes to align training system text with the measured runtime environment rather than leave stale or invented world claims.
runtime_truth_repair.risk: Static runtime facts embedded into training prose can immediately become stale; modern architecture should keep volatile facts in typed runtime state and train only the contract for reading them.

length_repair.finding: A full REALITY block caused severe sequence overflow. A later length-aware script inserted that block only when the complete example stayed inside a token budget, explicitly trading coverage for no truncation/content mismatch.
length_repair.historical_measured_claim: The full block was reported as 512 tokens and pushed 1082 examples beyond 2048; conditional insertion targeted about 25% coverage.

prompt_parity_repair.finding: A 505-character KRAFTAUSDRUECKE runtime block was found in zero v26.1 training examples, so v26.2 deterministically injected the exact fresh prompt block into training system texts. This is direct evidence that runtime-prompt parity was already recognized as a correctness requirement.

architecture_targeting.base_model_claim: Qwen3.5-4B hybrid with 32 layers: historical review records 8 layers with standard q/k/v/o attention projections and 24 layers with linear_attn projections.
architecture_targeting.v261_issue: LoRA on a small standard target subset reaches the conventional attention path in only part of the hybrid stack; MLP projections remain the main shared adapted path in the other layers.
architecture_targeting.v262_change: The v26.2 script targets the seven standard projections q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj. It explicitly leaves linear_attn projections for a separate experiment rather than mixing them into the A/B.
architecture_targeting.lesson: LoRA target discovery must be architecture-aware and measured against actual module topology, not assumed from common Transformer names.

overfit_risk.historical_dataset: 3785 examples, 2 epochs, answer-span-only loss; review records 167875 target tokens out of 4863646 total tokens (3.4%).
overfit_risk.historical_risk_signal: The review estimated v26.2 would have about 2.7x more trainable parameters on the same small target-token surface, raising trainable-parameter/target-token ratio from about 94:1 to about 253:1.
overfit_risk.mitigation_added: v26.2 added a 328-example never-trained eval set and periodic eval, so overfitting could be observed instead of inferred from train loss alone.

recovery_and_preflight.finding: The v26.2 wrapper restarts after process failure, resumes from checkpoints, stops on a FERTIG marker and has a 60-attempt loop guard. Separate smoke/preflight scripts test model loading, adapter placement, backward fit, span masking, curriculum sampler and required file topology before a full run.
recovery_and_preflight.lesson: Long training jobs should be restartable and preflight-gated, with explicit completion markers and bounded retry loops.

preserved_contradictions.artifact_a: pruefe_v262.py and unsloth_rauchtest.py explicitly expect/test MAX_LEN=2048.
preserved_contradictions.artifact_b: train_v262_unsloth.py contains MAX_LEN=2432 and states that 2048 would still truncate 288 examples while 2432 truncates zero.
preserved_contradictions.related_report: runde3_gegenleser.py still describes the planned v26.2 comparison as max_len 2048.
preserved_contradictions.rule: Do not report one canonical v26.2 max length until file chronology/build identity is reconciled.

preserved_contradictions.claim: Historical comments repeatedly call v26.2 a clean A/B against v26.1 with identical data.
preserved_contradictions.counterevidence: The final training script also adds the missing KRAFTAUSDRUECKE prompt block and a never-trained eval set; the review notes max length and target modules were changed together.
preserved_contradictions.rule: Treat it as a controlled lineage improvement attempt, not a scientifically clean single-variable causal experiment.

preserved_contradictions.artifact_a: 40_v261_fix.py describes insertion of a REALITY block in roughly 35% of stage-1/2 examples.
preserved_contradictions.artifact_b: 43_realitaet_laengenbewusst.py later replaces this with token-budget-aware insertion targeting roughly 25% to avoid truncation.
preserved_contradictions.rule: Keep both as historical stages; do not aggregate their percentages.

harness: Require an executable prompt/state-schema parity test between training examples and inference assembly.
Track LoRA target coverage by actual layer/module topology before training; report adapted layers and parameter counts by module family.
Report effective supervised target tokens separately from total context tokens and compute trainable-parameter/target-token ratios as an overfit risk signal.
Never call a run a clean A/B when more than one training variable or data transform changed; encode experiment factors explicitly.
Preflight sequence length against the full rendered corpus and forbid silent truncation of supervised answer spans.
claycode: Prompt assembly, runtime facts and supervised answer spans should be typed separately so rendering parity can be compiled and tested rather than maintained by copied strings.
Model topology introspection should generate adapter target sets; do not hard-code canonical Transformer projection names as universal truth.
unifieddb: Persist experiment factors, corpus hash, prompt-schema hash, model topology hash, target-module set, max length, supervised-token count and eval split identity as immutable run metadata.
claygraph: Represent v26.1->v26.2 as a version graph with multiple simultaneous factor edges and explicit contradiction nodes for stale preflight/report artifacts.
frank: Volatile reality/body facts should come from current typed state, not be baked as literal historical facts into weights; train the behavior of grounding on state instead.
needle: Effect/tool ownership is orthogonal to LoRA language training; avoid teaching obsolete executable syntax merely to match historical prompt text.
gwt: Runtime state should enter as current evidence with provenance rather than as memorized world text.
emergenz: Any behavioral improvement attributed to adapter expansion needs factor-isolated ablations because prompt/data/length changes can produce the same apparent gain.

security_and_authority.note: This receipt analyzes historical training code only; no current paid or local training was executed.
